title: Goes flat too fast
text: Goes flat too fast. Had this for about 6 months or so. It's now so flat it's uncomfortable to sit on. Kinda bummed it only last that long. Guess I will have to buy more beans. :( And the only people who sat on it were my 2 sons ages 9 and 10. So it wasn't that a heavy adult used it everyday.
